questions.question: A centurion in Capernaum sent Jewish elders to Jesus because his servant was sick. What did he ask Jesus to do?
A centurion told Jesus not to trouble Himself by coming to his house. How did he ask Jesus to heal his servant?

answers.text: By sending one of His disciples

questions.question: Jesus marveled at a centurion's faith. What did He tell the crowd about it?

answers.text: He had not found such great faith even in Israel
He had seen faith like this in every town
His faith still had to grow before the healing

questions.question: When the centurion's messengers returned to his house, they found the sick servant in good health. True or false?
